audit.why: Ranged in Mini, melee in Mega — the matchup flips on the Rage bar, not on levels. Aatrox wants every fight while Gnar is Mini and Hop is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: GNAR! (R) is 90/60/30 but only exists in Mega form, and it stuns anything thrown into a wall. World Ender (120/100/80) is the longer cooldown, so read the Rage bar before you spend it.
audit.corrected: GNAR! (R) exists only in Mega form on 90s — read the Rage bar, not the level. Fight him in Mini, and hold World Ender for the transform, since a wall stun opens his combo.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Hop/Crunch (E, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12) is his escape and his engage — Infernal Chains grounds it, so W lands the fight. Wallop (W in Mega, 7s) is the knock-up that starts his combo.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gnar. Infernal Chains (W) grounds and drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — hold it for Hop (E, 22s at rank 1) and he cannot leap out. Fight him in Mini form: in Mega, Wallop (W, 7s) knocks you up and GNAR! stuns you against a wall. Save World Ender for the transform, never a single Q.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Gnar's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: GNAR! (R) exists only in Mega form on 90s — read the Rage bar, not the level. Fight him in Mini, and hold World Ender for the transform, since a wall stun opens his combo.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gnar. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. He's mobile, so hold W until after he commits his dash, then chain him so he can't reset or kite your Q. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive GNAR! — never burn it for a single Q.
